topic: Permenkumham 22/2024 — KITAS pensionato: cosa cambia per chi ha già il KITAP

regulatory_flag.detail: NB-2 (97 sources, ground truth) explicitly confirms NO regulation named 'Permenkumham No. 22 Tahun 2024' exists. The topic likely conflates two distinct instruments: Permenkumham 22/2023 (main visa/stay-permit reform) amended by Permenkumham 11/2024. Storyboarder MUST NOT use 'Permenkumham 22/2024' as a regulatory citation. The carousel should be framed around the 2023-2024 reform package.
actual_governing_regulations: Permenkumham 22/2023 (base regulation — visa and izin tinggal system overhaul)
Permenkumham 11/2024 (amendment to 22/2023 — Golden Visa policy adjustments, sponsor definitions)
UU No. 63/2024 (national immigration law amendment — MERP integration)
PP 31/2013 (underlying framework — KITAS→KITAP transition rules, 3-year minimum)

key_facts: No Permenkumham 22/2024 exists — topic refers to the Permenkumham 22/2023 + 11/2024 reform package — NB-2 [IMM-356]
Existing KITAP holders face ZERO mandatory conversion: all permits issued before the new regulations remain fully valid until their natural expiry date — NB-2 [IMM-356, IMM-354]
On next renewal, new KITAP documents automatically incorporate updated regulations — no special action required from the holder — NB-2 source 27394849
UU 63/2024 abolished the MERP (Multiple Exit Re-entry Permit) as a separate document: MERP is now automatically integrated into KITAP from date of issuance — NB-2 [IMM-362]
KITAP-RET (retirement permanent residency) is granted initially for 5 years, then renewable for unlimited duration (jangka waktu tidak terbatas) — NB-2 source d14f6c39
KITAP unlimited-duration holders must report (Lapor) to their local Kantor Imigrasi every 5 years — this check-in is FREE of charge — NB-2 [IMM-195], Permenkumham-29-2021 Pasal 144 Ayat 1
KITAP renewal window: application may be submitted earliest 3 months before expiry and no later than the expiry date itself — NB-2 Pasal 128 Ayat 3

Overstay protection: if KITAP renewal is filed AND government fee (PNBP) paid before expiry, the holder is NOT considered in overstay even if processing extends past the original expiry date — NB-2 Pasal 128 Ayat 4
KITAP holders are independent of sponsor obligation for ongoing residency (unlike KITAS E33F which requires a licensed agency sponsor) — NB-2 [IMM-100]

New sponsor rules under Permenimipas 5/2025 (superseding Permenkumham 36/2021) affect KITAP at the application/renewal submission stage: a penjamin (sponsor/guarantor) must formally file the renewal request — NB-2 [IMM-366]
If passport is renewed, holder must update KITAP with new passport number at Kantor Imigrasi — this is a distinct and separate procedure from MERP and is still required — NB-2 source 27394849
KITAP-RET eligibility requires: minimum age 55+, minimum 5 years continuous retirement KITAS (E33E or E33F categories) — NB-2 source d14f6c39 + 2d2ec0af
The ministry overseeing immigration changed in 2024: from Kemenkumham to the new Kementerian Imigrasi dan Pemasyarakatan (Kemenimipas) — NB-2 [IMM-365]
KITAP independent of sponsor for daily residency: the sponsor supervision obligation applies only to KITAS holders, not KITAP holders — NB-2 [IMM-100]

5 years — minimum retirement KITAS tenure before KITAP-RET eligibility
IDR 45,000,000 — KITAP-RET government fee (PNBP) — NB-2 source 2d2ec0af
18 months — minimum remaining passport validity required for KITAP renewal application

taboo_check: DO NOT use 'Permenkumham 22/2024' as a regulatory citation — this regulation does not exist; use '22/2023 + 11/2024 reform package'
DO NOT say 'nothing changes' without specifying scope — MERP integration and new sponsor rules DO change
DO NOT say 'your KITAP is permanent forever' — first issuance is 5-year, only after renewal does unlimited duration apply
DO NOT imply KITAP holders need no sponsor — a penjamin is still required to FILE the renewal application
DO NOT omit the passport-update requirement — if passport renewed, KITAP update is still mandatory
DO NOT use 'easy', 'simple fix', 'no worries' — regulatory compliance requires concrete action
DO NOT conflate KITAS and KITAP rules — sponsor dependency is category-specific
DO NOT say 'MERP is no longer needed' without clarifying scope: old MERP documents remain valid until their expiry; only NEW issuances auto-include MERP
